clauses.name: PrepareForOrdinaryCall
clauses.requirement: The callee execution context uses the actual function and its immutable [[Realm]], independently of [[Environment]].

clauses.name: OrdinaryFunctionCreate
clauses.requirement: Creation Realm and lexical environment are separate internal slots; mutable function prototypes do not establish Realm identity.

changes: call_jit_fast uses immutable UserCallable.realm equality instead of an eight-parent lexical-environment walk.
jit_call_hit_inner lends the existing packed callee owner through PackedValue::with_object for observer-free identity/environment inspection.
preserved_guards: Active global-environment identity and Weak allocation pins on every call-cache fill/hit.
under_with, class-constructor, prepared-entry and resumable-frame exclusions.
Normative Realm switching for foreign callees, proxy/bound dispatch and this binding.
GC safepoints, canonical operands, frame/exception cleanup and final owner destruction.
implementation.prerequisite: Immutable UserCallable.realm identity/callee_realm_global main correctness fix; snapshots include current Realm-aware dispatch and Weak planning-global-env pins.
implementation.independent_review: Root and review_changes independently reviewed the production proof and focused fixtures before unchanged v2 integration; no actionable issue found.

source_base_inventory.production_prerequisite: Immutable UserCallable.realm identity/callee_realm_global main correctness fix; snapshots include current Realm-aware dispatch and Weak planning-global-env pins.

source.coverage_of_embedded_source: Exact patch, complete modified production functions before/after, complete test module and full-file prerequisite/candidate hashes. Unchanged portions of the large production files are identified by hashes and tracked repository paths.

isolated_full_engine_source_inventory.scope: All files in the exact isolated trust-js crate used for compilation plus workspace Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; includes all compiler modules, fixtures, self-hosted source and data. Restored candidate source, matching the passing runs.

root_frozen_v2_inventory.scope: Root independently froze the integrated compiler-v2 source; whole-v2 validation/performance evidence belongs to its separate record.
